assistant.title: {app} Assistant
assistant.what_p: The {app} assistant helps you prepare, organise and convert your files. You describe what you want to achieve and it guides you step by step.
assistant.can_1: Answer your questions about preparing and formatting your files.
assistant.can_2: Suggest a procedure tailored to your needs.
assistant.can_3: Point you to the right resource when it cannot handle the request.
assistant.cannot_h: What the assistant does not do
assistant.cannot_1: It does not make decisions for you: you stay in control of your files.
assistant.cannot_2: It does not keep your conversations beyond what is described in the {privacy_link}.
assistant.cannot_3: It is not a substitute for professional advice (legal, accounting or technical).
assistant.help_p: For any question, bug report or suggestion, open a ticket on GitHub:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how {app} and its assistant process your data. We follow a simple principle: collect only what is strictly necessary for the service to work.
privacy.s1_p: The {app} service is published by its author, who can be reached through the project page on GitHub:
privacy.s2_1_b: Content of your exchanges with the assistant:
privacy.s2_1: the messages you send are processed only to generate a reply.
privacy.s2_2: the files you submit are processed only to carry out the requested operation. They are not kept once the operation is complete.
privacy.s2_3: minimal technical information (browser type, timestamp, errors) may be recorded to keep the service running and secure.
privacy.s3_1: Provide the service and respond to your requests.
privacy.s3_2: Ensure security, detect abuse and fix errors.
privacy.s3_3: Improve the service, using only aggregated and anonymised data.
privacy.s4_1: We do not sell your data.
privacy.s4_2: We do not use your files or conversations for advertising.
privacy.s4_3: We do not share your data with third parties, except technical providers strictly required to run the service or where the law requires it.
privacy.s5_1: Submitted files: deleted as soon as processing is complete.
privacy.s5_2: Conversations with the assistant: not kept beyond the session, except for technical logs.
privacy.s5_3: Technical logs: kept for a maximum of 30 days.
privacy.s6_p: To produce its replies, the assistant may rely on a language model provider. The data sent is limited to what is needed for the reply and is covered by that provider's confidentiality commitments.
privacy.s7_p: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your data. To exercise these rights, open a ticket on {issues_link}. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.s8_p: These pages use no cookies or trackers.
privacy.s9_p: This policy may be updated. The date of the latest update appears at the top of this page.
